description:
• About INFIN8 Mercantile and Products:
INFIN8 Mercantile creates cozy-lux home décor and lifestyle pieces designed to help people build spaces that feel warm, personal, and collected. Collections are built around original nature-inspired artwork and coordinated patterns that work together across products including blankets, pillows, candles, kitchen textiles, wall art, pet portraits, and seasonal homewares. Products are designed to help customers style their homes with less guesswork and more confidence.

• What Makes INFIN8 Mercantile Different:

  • Original artist-created pattern collections
  • Pattern-led decorating designed to coordinate across multiple products
  • Cozy-lux aesthetic inspired by curated homes and layered interiors
  • Nature-inspired artwork with botanical, whimsical, and seasonal themes
  • Made-to-order products created with attention to detail
  • Mix-and-match collections designed to grow over time instead of one-time purchases
  • Designs created to become part of everyday living, not temporary trends

• How Affiliates Can Earn:
Affiliates earn a commission on qualifying purchases made through their affiliate links and/or personal coupon codes. Earnings increase naturally as content reaches new audiences and repeat customers discover additional products and collections.

• How to Promote INFIN8 Mercantile:

  • Share lifestyle photos and videos featuring products in real spaces
  • Create styling content showing how pieces work together
  • Share seasonal decorating inspiration
  • Create gift guides for pet lovers, home décor lovers, book lovers, and holiday shoppers
  • Share unboxing videos, room refreshes, cozy corners, and before/after styling content
  • Include affiliate links and coupon codes in captions, stories, profiles, blogs, and videos
  • Highlight pattern collections and coordinated products rather than single items whenever possible

• Other Information:

  • New products and coordinated additions are regularly introduced into existing collections
  • Authentic content consistently performs better than heavily scripted promotions
  • Bright, clean, natural imagery typically converts better than overly edited content
  • Lifestyle content showing products in everyday spaces generally creates stronger engagement than standalone product photos
  • INFIN8 Mercantile focuses on thoughtful design, seasonal styling, and creating pieces that feel like they belong in a home for years rather than weeks

Affiliate Earnings & Payouts
Commissions are paid monthly on the 15th of each month for eligible completed orders from the previous month. Orders must clear any return, cancellation, or refund periods before commissions become payable.
